description: Validation recorded for a variable describes its current value. A redefinition from new data, or a self-update that mixes in unvalidated data, is not validated; a self-update of the validated value alone stays validated. A request read inlined beside a validated operand is new data too.

expected.notes: host was re-read from req.query.other after the check
req.query.extra is appended after the check
the unvalidated local `extra` is appended after the check
trim/toLowerCase only transform the validated value
normalize only transforms the validated value
a literal suffix adds no attacker data
req.query.limit joins the query unvalidated beside the allowlisted sort
only the allowlisted sort reaches the query
